definitions.explanation: A pre-mixed seasoning liquid made primarily of soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and dashi, used as a base for dishes like sukiyaki.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}り{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{割|わ}り{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧。
examples.english: Add the sauce and simmer the sukiyaki.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{割|わ}り{下|した}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甘|あま}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げている→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: This sauce is finished on the sweeter side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{割|わ}り{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: You can easily make sukiyaki using store-bought sauce.

notes:
{割|わ}り{下|した} is the sauce base for sukiyaki and similar dishes.

BASIC RECIPE:
Typically made by mixing:
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧: soy sauce
- みりん: mirin (sweet rice wine)
- ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧: sugar
- ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ or ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧: dashi or water

REGIONAL VARIATIONS:
- Kanto style: Pre-mixed {割|わ}り{下|した} is poured over ingredients
- Kansai style: Sugar and soy sauce are added separately while cooking

USAGE:
Can also be used for other simmered dishes like {肉豆腐|にくどうふ} and ⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧.
